display.description: Ready the Larder quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Ready the Larder

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
Ready the Larder is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Good. A full shelf makes brave talk sound less hollow. Take this with my thanks.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: I still count fewer than 16 bread. Close, maybe, but hungry math is strict.
missing_proof: Bring back the proof item before we close this.
missing_target: You still need to reach the place I marked.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then I will keep counting crumbs and pretending it is planning.
The bins are low. Nothing dramatic, which is usually when it becomes dramatic.
A few good loaves would quiet half the village by sunset.

responses.label: I can help stock the larder.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Sixteen bread, if you can spare it. The larder does not need heroics today, just weight on the shelf.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: Ready the Larder is already settled.
locate_failed: I cannot find a clean mark for that place today.
started: Bring me 16 bread. Simple work, but it keeps people steady.
unavailable: This is not the right season for that request.

lines: If that pack smells like fresh bread, you may have saved me an argument.
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
